snapshot_0: SELECT i.sku, SUM(i.quantity) AS available FROM inventory AS i GROUP BY i.sku HAVING SUM(i.quantity) >= CAST(? AS INT)
result_set_1: SELECT s.sku, s.available, CASE WHEN s.available < 5 THEN 'low' ELSE 'ready' END AS stock_level FROM TABLE(sku BIGINT = ?, available BIGINT = ?) AS s ORDER BY s.available DESC, s.sku
